name: renderPromptSection
description: Render a named system-prompt section to text. The C++ side knows the catalog and walks the conditional logic that used to live in the TS getUsingYourToolsSection. JS substitutes the returned text into the .md template's placeholder slot.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Section name. Currently 'using-your-tools' is the only supported value (it fills the {{TOOL_CATALOG}} placeholder).

inputs.name: enabledToolNames
inputs.description: Set of tool names the JS-side runtime considers enabled this turn. The renderer composes prose conditionally based on which categories (browser, file, bash, etc.) are present.
